patterns.name: Cloud public exposure with privilege path

tests.name: shared-resource-positive
tests.description: Matches when public exposure and privilege-path findings share a resource inside the window.

patterns.name: GitHub secret scanning control disabled with secret alert

tests.name: shared-repository-positive
tests.description: Matches when secret scanning is disabled and a secret alert lands on the same repository inside the window.

tests.name: window-negative
tests.description: Does not match when the control-disable and alert findings exceed the configured window.

patterns.name: Identity control tamper with credential change

tests.name: shared-actor-positive
tests.description: Matches when the same actor changes an identity control and creates a credential inside the window.
